光路为教学示意，棱镜色散间距经过放大；光带连续渐变。: Teaching diagrams: prism dispersion is exaggerated; colour bands vary continuously.
阳光包含连续的可见光谱。不同波长在玻璃中的折射率不同，棱镜把它们分开。演示使用连: Sunlight contains a continuous visible spectrum. Different wavelengths refract differently in glass. Continuous colour bands and exaggerated spacing make the paths easier to see. “Combine spectrum” shows schematic recombination with a lens, not a precise experimental setup.
水滴按球形截面处理。主虹光线经过两次折射和一次内反射，副虹多一次内反射。反射仅带: Drops are shown in spherical cross-section. Primary rays refract twice and reflect once; secondary rays reflect once more. Reflection carries only part of the energy. Reflectance depends on angle and polarisation, not a fixed percentage.
约 42° 和 51° 是相对反太阳方向的角半径。本页按各色折射率计算角度。主虹: About 42° and 51° are angular radii from the antisolar direction. Values here are calculated from each colour’s index. Between the bows these two ray families do not contribute, so it looks darker, but it is not devoid of all light.
彩虹围绕反太阳点。地面视图假定平坦、不透明的地面；太阳越高，露出的弧越少。“无遮: Rainbows surround the antisolar point. Ground view assumes level opaque terrain; a higher Sun reveals less of the bow. Full-circle view assumes suitable mist in all relevant directions and an unobstructed view below. Elevation can help, but does not guarantee a full circle.

球形雨滴的放大剖面: Magnified cross-section of a spherical drop
每个颜色，都有自己的路线。: Each colour follows its own path.
白光包含连续分布的可见波长。折射率 n 描述介质中的相速度与真空光速的关系；在色: White light contains a continuous range of visible wavelengths. Refractive index n relates phase velocity in a medium to light speed in vacuum. In a dispersive medium n depends on wavelength, allowing different wavelengths to leave a prism in different directions.
界面折射与法线角度: Refraction and angles to the normal
斯涅尔定律连接界面两侧的传播方向。角度应相对法线测量，而不是相对玻璃边缘；从空气: Snell’s law relates propagation directions on either side of an interface. Angles are measured from the normal, not from the glass edge. Light entering higher-index glass from air generally bends toward the normal.
普通玻璃在可见光范围通常表现为正常色散，短波长折射率较高。棱镜两界面的法线不平行: Ordinary glass usually shows normal dispersion in the visible range, with higher index at shorter wavelengths. A prism’s interface normals are not parallel; the two refractions produce a net deviation that separates wavelengths spatially.
若把分开的光谱重新导向同一区域，各波长的光能可以叠加，人眼可能重新感到白色。恢复: Redirecting separated spectral components into one region lets their optical contributions add and may restore a white appearance. The result depends on spectrum and relative intensities; this is neither pigment mixing nor the creation of colors by the prism.
从平面界面到球面雨滴: From planar interfaces to a spherical drop
棱镜演示的是色散，雨滴还包含曲面几何和内部反射。球面上不同入射位置具有不同法线，: The prism demonstrates dispersion, whereas a raindrop adds curved geometry and internal reflection. Different entry points on a sphere have different normals; the concentration of emerging rays near special angles explains the bright bow.
将雨滴近似为均匀球体，入射参数 b 是光线到圆心的垂直距离除以半径。由圆的几何与: For a uniform spherical drop, impact parameter b is the ray’s perpendicular distance from the center divided by radius. Circular geometry and Snell’s law give incidence i and internal refraction r, defining the ray path.
部分内反射与能量分配: Partial internal reflection and energy splitting
光从水中到达水气界面时，通常同时存在反射和透射。主虹所需的内部反射并非全内反射；: At a water–air interface, reflection and transmission usually coexist. The reflection involved in the primary bow is not total internal reflection. Its fraction depends on angle and polarization; the diagram follows only the bow-producing branch.
从光路偏转到观察角: From ray deviation to viewing angle
一次内反射加两次折射给出主虹的总偏转角。将出射方向换成相对反太阳方向的角半径，可: One internal reflection and two refractions determine the primary ray deviation. Expressing the emerging direction as angular radius around the antisolar direction gives θ = 4r − 2i. Different indices give different angles for the same impact parameter.
各波长在其主虹极值角附近聚集。水对紫光的折射率较高，对应较小的主虹角半径；因此红: Each wavelength concentrates near its own primary rainbow extremum. Water’s higher index for violet gives a smaller primary angular radius, placing red outside violet. Comparisons should use the extremal ray for each wavelength.
对 θ(b) 求导并令其为零，得到主虹极值的入射参数 b*。相邻入射光在这里以相: Setting the derivative of θ(b) to zero gives the extremal impact parameter b*. Neighboring incident rays emerge at similar angles, creating a geometrical-optics caustic. Wave optics gives the bright edge a finite structure and width.
主虹角半径是单次内反射光路的极大值，红光约 42°。其以内的许多方向也能接收这类: The primary angular radius is a maximum of one-reflection paths, about 42° for red. Many interior directions also receive such rays, making the sky inside the bow relatively bright rather than leaving only an isolated colored line.
增加一次内反射后，出射方向的角度关系改变，副虹出现于更大的角半径。其极值是极小值: With an extra internal reflection, the angular relation changes and the secondary bow occurs at larger radii. Its extremum is a minimum, about 51° for red and 54° for violet; the primary-angle formula cannot be reused.
折射率随波长的排序没有翻转，但主虹与副虹的角度对折射率的响应不同。因此副虹红内紫: The wavelength ordering of refractive index does not reverse, but primary and secondary angles respond differently to index. The secondary is therefore red inside and violet outside, opposite the primary; this is not merely a mirrored drawing.
亚历山大暗带的几何来源: The geometry of Alexander’s dark band
主虹极大角与副虹极小角之间，理想球滴的一次、二次内反射分支不能有效供光。相较两侧: Between the primary maximum and secondary minimum, one- and two-reflection branches of ideal spherical drops do not effectively supply rays. This region is darker than its neighbors, but atmospheric scattering, multiple scattering and background light still illuminate it.
每次遇到界面，反射与透射都会重新分配光能。副虹多一次内反射，通常较弱；偏振、雨滴: Every interface partitions energy between reflection and transmission. An extra internal reflection usually weakens the secondary. Polarization, drop-size distribution, ray concentration and background also affect brightness, so no universal primary-to-secondary ratio exists.
反太阳方向与太阳方向相反。太阳仰角为 h 时，反太阳点相对同一地平线的高度为 −: The antisolar direction is opposite the Sun. If solar elevation is h, antisolar altitude relative to the same horizon is −h. Bow geometry changes with the observer; the antisolar point is not a fixed distant object.
圆锥方向与天空圆弧: A cone of directions and a circle on the sky
所有与反太阳轴夹角约为虹角的视线构成圆锥面，在天空方向空间中是圆。不同距离的雨滴: Sightlines at the rainbow angle to the antisolar axis form a cone and a circle in sky-direction space. Drops at different distances can contribute, so this is a set of directions rather than a circular sheet at one distance.
在平坦地面且下方被遮挡的近似中，主虹最高点高度约为虹角减太阳高度。太阳越高，可见: For a flat ground view with the lower sky blocked, the primary’s top altitude is roughly rainbow angle minus solar elevation. As the Sun rises, the visible arc sinks; above about 42°, this ground-view primary can lie entirely below the horizon.
不被地面裁切只是条件之一，完整圆周的相应方向还需要有合适的水滴和日照。高处、瀑布: Removing horizon obstruction is only one condition: suitable illuminated drops must also be present around the required directions. Heights, waterfalls or sprays may help. Full-circle mode demonstrates geometry, not a guarantee at every elevated viewpoint.
观察者移动后，满足入眼角度条件的雨滴集合随之改变。两人可看到相似形状的彩虹，但接: Moving changes the set of drops satisfying the angle needed to reach the eye. Two observers may see similar bows but receive light from different drops, so there is no fixed rainbow foot to walk toward.
